## Phase: Awareness
- User first heard about the product through a colleague's recommendation at a team meeting.
- They searched for alternatives online and compared several options before landing on this one.
- The landing page was confusing — they couldn't figure out what the product actually did from the headline.

## Phase: Onboarding
- Signing up was quick, but the email verification step failed twice before finally working.
- The setup wizard was helpful but felt overwhelming — too many options presented at once.
- User couldn't find where to import their existing data. They spent 20 minutes looking before giving up.
- First time experience: user was excited but confused about where to start.

## Phase: Core Use
- Daily use is mostly smooth, but the search function is frustratingly slow.
- Users love the collaborative features — this is consistently the highlight mentioned in sessions.
- Creating a new project requires too many clicks. Users wish there was a faster way.
- The export feature doesn't work with their file format. This is a critical blocker for some teams.
- Notifications are confusing — users can't tell which ones are important vs noise.

## Phase: Problem
- When something goes wrong, the error messages are completely unhelpful — just error codes.
- Support chat is slow to respond. Users feel abandoned when they're stuck.
- The workaround for the export issue involves downloading a third-party plugin — users hate this.

## Phase: Resolution
- Eventually users figure out the workaround and feel proud of themselves, but annoyed it was necessary.
- Power users develop their own shortcuts that make daily use faster.
- Long-term users are satisfied overall, but always mention the onboarding as a rough start.
